title: MCPokedex Agent — Grafo de ejecución
description: Grafo de ejecución del agente sobre las trazas de Phoenix (Postgres): mapa agregado de agentes, modelos y tools, y el recorrido de una consulta.

list.name: project
list.label: Proyecto (env)
list.query: SELECT name FROM projects WHERE name LIKE 'mcpokedex-%' ORDER BY name = 'mcpokedex-prod' DESC, name
list.definition: SELECT name FROM projects WHERE name LIKE 'mcpokedex-%'

list.name: trace_id
list.label: Consulta
list.query:
SELECT t.trace_id AS __value,
       to_char(s.start_time, 'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || left(coalesce(s.attributes #>> '{input,value}', '—'), 60) AS __text
FROM spans s
JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_rowid
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_rowid
WHERE p.name = '$project' AND s.parent_id IS NULL AND s.span_kind = 'AGENT' AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time)
ORDER BY s.start_time DESC
LIMIT 100
list.definition: Consultas (spans AGENT raíz) del rango, la más reciente primero

panels.title: Mapa de agentes
panels.description: Agentes, modelos y tools del rango, en columnas: agente raíz, sub-agentes, modelos y tools. Nodo: llamadas, p95 y fracción con error (arco rojo). Arista: quién llama a quién (pasa el cursor para ver llamadas y p95); en rojo si más del 5% de esas llamadas terminó en error.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sp AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.span_id, s.parent_id, s.trace_rowid, s.span_kind, s.status_code,
         extract(epoch FROM s.end_time - s.start_time) AS dur,
         s.attributes #>> '{graph,node,parent_id}' AS parent_agent,
         CASE s.span_kind
           WHEN 'AGENT' THEN 'agent:' || coalesce(s.attributes #>> '{agent,name}', s.name)
           WHEN 'LLM' THEN 'llm:' || coalesce(s.attributes #>> '{llm,model_name}', s.name)
           ELSE lower(s.span_kind) || ':' || s.name
         END AS node
  FROM spans s
  JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_rowid
  JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_rowid
  WHERE p.name = '$project' AND $__timeFilter(t.start_time)
)
, roots AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT node FROM sp WHERE parent_id IS NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT node, lower(min(span_kind)) AS kind, count(*) AS calls,
         percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dur) AS p95,
         avg((status_code = 'ERROR')::int) AS errors,
         max(CASE
               WHEN span_kind = 'LLM' THEN 3
               WHEN span_kind <> 'AGENT' THEN 4
               WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN 0
               WHEN coalesce('agent:' || parent_agent IN (SELECT node FROM roots), true) THEN 1
               ELSE 2
             END) AS level
  FROM sp
  GROUP BY node
), grid AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY node) - 1 AS r, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS in_level
  FROM stats
), cells AS (
  SELECT *, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY level, r / 4) - 1 AS col, r % 4 AS line, least(4, in_level - (r / 4) * 4) AS lines
  FROM grid
)
SELECT node AS id, substr(node, strpos(node, ':') + 1) AS title, kind AS subtitle,
       calls::text AS mainstat,
       'p95 ' || round(p95::numeric, 2) || ' s' AS secondarystat,
       (1 - errors)::float8 AS arc__ok,
       errors::float8 AS arc__error,
       round(100.0 * errors, 1) || ' %' AS detail__errores,
       ((col - max(col) OVER () / 2.0) * 240)::float8 AS fixedx,
       ((line - (lines - 1) / 2.0 + (col % 2) * 0.5 - 0.25) * 115)::float8 AS fixedy
FROM cells
ORDER BY node

WITH sp AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.span_id, s.parent_id, s.trace_rowid, s.span_kind, s.status_code,
         extract(epoch FROM s.end_time - s.start_time) AS dur,
         s.attributes #>> '{graph,node,parent_id}' AS parent_agent,
         CASE s.span_kind
           WHEN 'AGENT' THEN 'agent:' || coalesce(s.attributes #>> '{agent,name}', s.name)
           WHEN 'LLM' THEN 'llm:' || coalesce(s.attributes #>> '{llm,model_name}', s.name)
           ELSE lower(s.span_kind) || ':' || s.name
         END AS node
  FROM spans s
  JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_rowid
  JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_rowid
  WHERE p.name = '$project' AND $__timeFilter(t.start_time)
)
SELECT pa.node || ' → ' || ch.node AS id, pa.node AS source, ch.node AS target,
       count(*)::text AS mainstat,
       'p95 ' || round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ch.dur)::numeric, 2) || ' s' AS secondarystat,
       round(100.0 * avg((ch.status_code = 'ERROR')::int), 1) || ' %' AS detail__errores,
       CASE WHEN avg((ch.status_code = 'ERROR')::int) > 0.05 THEN 'red' END AS color
FROM sp ch
JOIN sp pa ON pa.trace_rowid = ch.trace_rowid AND pa.span_id = ch.parent_id
GROUP BY pa.node, ch.node
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Consultas recientes
panels.description: Clic en la consulta para ver su recorrido abajo; trace_id abre la traza en Phoenix.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.start_time AS inicio,
       left(coalesce(s.attributes #>> '{input,value}', '—'), 120) AS consulta,
       round(extract(epoch FROM s.end_time - s.start_time)::numeric, 2) AS segundos,
       s.status_code AS estado,
       s.cumulative_llm_token_count_prompt + s.cumulative_llm_token_count_completion AS tokens,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM spans c WHERE c.trace_rowid = s.trace_rowid) AS spans,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM spans c WHERE c.trace_rowid = s.trace_rowid AND c.span_kind = 'AGENT') - 1 AS sub_agentes,
       t.trace_id,
       encode(convert_to('Project:' || p.id, 'UTF8'), 'base64') AS phoenix_project
FROM spans s
JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_rowid
JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_rowid
WHERE p.name = '$project' AND s.parent_id IS NULL AND s.span_kind = 'AGENT' AND $__timeFilter(s.start_time)
ORDER BY s.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recorrido de una consulta
panels.description: Cada span de la consulta elegida: de izquierda a derecha en orden de inicio, hacia abajo por profundidad. Línea continua: padre → hijo (duración del hijo). Línea punteada: orden entre hermanos (pausa en ms; naranja si se solapan, es decir, corrieron en paralelo).

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE tr AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.span_id, s.parent_id, s.span_kind, s.name, s.status_code, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.attributes,
         s.llm_token_count_prompt, s.llm_token_count_completion
  FROM spans s
  JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_rowid
  JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_rowid
  WHERE t.trace_id = '$trace_id' AND p.name = '$project'
), tree AS (
  SELECT span_id, 0 AS depth FROM tr WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ch.span_id, tree.depth + 1 FROM tr ch JOIN tree ON ch.parent_id = tree.span_id
), sp AS (
  SELECT tr.*, coalesce(tree.depth, 0) AS depth,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY tr.start_time, tr.span_id) - 1 AS pos,
         count(*) OVER () AS n,
         max(coalesce(tree.depth, 0)) OVER () AS max_depth,
         min(tr.start_time) OVER () AS t0
  FROM tr
  LEFT JOIN tree USING (span_id)
)
SELECT span_id AS id,
       CASE span_kind
         WHEN 'AGENT' THEN coalesce(attributes #>> '{agent,name}', name)
         WHEN 'LLM' THEN coalesce(attributes #>> '{llm,model_name}', name)
         ELSE name
       END AS title,
       lower(span_kind) || ' · +' || round(extract(epoch FROM start_time - t0) * 1000) || ' ms' AS subtitle,
       round(extract(epoch FROM end_time - start_time)::numeric, 2) || ' s' AS mainstat,
       CASE WHEN span_kind = 'LLM'
            THEN coalesce(llm_token_count_prompt, 0) + coalesce(llm_token_count_completion, 0) || ' tok'
       END AS secondarystat,
       (status_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'ERROR')::int::float8 AS arc__ok,
       (status_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'ERROR')::int::float8 AS arc__error,
       left(attributes #>> '{input,value}', 200) AS detail__input,
       left(attributes #>> '{output,value}', 200) AS detail__output,
       attributes #>> '{metadata,cache}' AS detail__cache,
       ((pos - (n - 1) / 2.0) * least(170, greatest(115, 1500.0 / n)))::float8 AS fixedx,
       ((depth - max_depth / 2.0) * 150)::float8 AS fixedy
FROM sp
ORDER BY pos

WITH RECURSIVE tr AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.span_id, s.parent_id, s.span_kind, s.name, s.status_code, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.attributes,
         s.llm_token_count_prompt, s.llm_token_count_completion
  FROM spans s
  JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_rowid
  JOIN projects p ON p.id = t.project_rowid
  WHERE t.trace_id = '$trace_id' AND p.name = '$project'
), tree AS (
  SELECT span_id, 0 AS depth FROM tr WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ch.span_id, tree.depth + 1 FROM tr ch JOIN tree ON ch.parent_id = tree.span_id
), sp AS (
  SELECT tr.*, coalesce(tree.depth, 0) AS depth,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY tr.start_time, tr.span_id) - 1 AS pos,
         count(*) OVER () AS n,
         max(coalesce(tree.depth, 0)) OVER () AS max_depth,
         min(tr.start_time) OVER () AS t0
  FROM tr
  LEFT JOIN tree USING (span_id)
)
SELECT 'p:' || ch.span_id AS id, ch.parent_id AS source, ch.span_id AS target,
       round(extract(epoch FROM ch.end_time - ch.start_time)::numeric, 2) || ' s' AS mainstat,
       'padre → hijo' AS detail__relacion,
       NULL::text AS color, NULL::text AS strokedasharray
FROM sp ch
JOIN sp pa ON pa.span_id = ch.parent_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 's:' || span_id, prev_id, span_id,
       round(gap_ms) || ' ms',
       CASE WHEN gap_ms < 0 THEN 'paralelo' ELSE 'secuencia' END,
       CASE WHEN gap_ms < 0 THEN 'orange' ELSE 'gray' END, '6 4'
FROM (
  SELECT span_id,
         lag(span_id) OVER w AS prev_id,
         extract(epoch FROM start_time - lag(end_time) OVER w) * 1000 AS gap_ms
  FROM sp
  WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY parent_id ORDER BY start_time, span_id)
) seq
WHERE prev_id IS NOT NULL AND '$secuencia' = 'on'
ORDER BY 1
